summary: Submitted a combined obligation+check product exposing a voter-quorum defect on the leadership-verification path, with preflight returning valid:true. Claim created: c-verify-leader-voter-quorum (concern consensus_safety) - Raft.VerifyLeader may report success only when a quorum of the voting configuration has acknowledged, so acknowledgements from non-voters may not count, because the accessor is documented as the guard against returning stale data after leadership is lost. Basis: map objects f-leadership-held and its consumer b-client-apply-verify, with b-heartbeat-liveness and b-leader-lease-stepdown as support and the existing material s-api-verify-leader; new binding bind-raft-verify-leader-quorum anchored at the VerifyLeader declaration (api.go 883-893). The source reading that motivates it: verifyLeader counts the leader's own vote and sizes the quorum with r.quorumSize(), which counts only Voter-suffrage servers, but registers the future with every follower replication state - which the leader builds from all servers of the latest configuration, non-voters included - and each replication goroutine adds a vote as soon as its heartbeat RPC succeeds. Harness check-harness-verify-ack.go: a three-server configuration with two voters and one non-voter elects a leader, the leader's route to the other voter is removed with the transport's own Disconnect while the non-voter keeps answering, and the leader then calls VerifyLeader; local execution emitted verification_setup (voters 2, nonvoters 1, quorum_size 2, other_voter n2, non_voter n3, leader_state Leader) and verification_observed with other_voter_reachable false, verification_result success, empty error and leader_state Leader. The plan asserts verification_result ne success with applicability on the configuration and the unreachable voter, identity fields cluster/op; an initial attempt to also condition applicability on the result field was rejected by preflight as filtering on the checked field, so that condition was removed and the timeout limitation recorded instead. Counterevidence retained: the leader is still in the leader state, no source states a non-voter's acknowledgement was meant to count, and a direct FSM reader is unaffected. Remaining capacity is about 2 audit units, 21 experiments and 10 minutes, so the next turn should review this artifact after the runner executes it.
